from pathlib import Path
import json,re,random,hashlib
root=Path('/home/t3/.cache/kuz-linear-factor/frozen75')
source=(root/'toeplitz_core_broadcast.zig').read_text()
encoded=(root/'encoded_seeded_broadcast.zig').read_text()
def mul(a,b):
    out=0
    for _ in range(8):
        if b&1:out^=a
        a=((a<<1)^(0xc3 if a&128 else 0))&255
        b>>=1
    return out
def vector(text,name):
    match=re.search(r'pub const '+name+r' = \[16\]u8\{([^}]+)\}',text)
    return [int(x) for x in match[1].split(',') if x.strip()]
r=vector(source,'row_scale');c=vector(source,'column_scale')
ri=vector(source,'row_inverse');ci=vector(source,'column_inverse')
assert all(mul(a,b)==1 for a,b in zip(r,ri))
assert all(mul(a,b)==1 for a,b in zip(c,ci))
body=source[source.index('pub inline fn forward('):source.index('pub inline fn inverse(')]
nodes=re.findall(r'const (v\d+) = ([^;]+);',body)
outputs=re.search(r'return \.\{([^}]+)\};',body)[1].split(',')
def evaluate(input):
    values={}
    def term(t):
        t=t.strip()
        if t.startswith('input['):return input[int(t[6:-1])]
        return values[t]
    for name,expr in nodes:
        match=re.fullmatch(r'multiply\(T, ([^,]+), (\d+)\)',expr.strip())
        if match:value=mul(term(match[1]),int(match[2]))
        else:
            value=0
            for t in expr.split('^'):value^=term(t)
        values[name]=value
    return [values[t.strip()] for t in outputs]
coeff=[148,32,133,16,194,192,1,251,1,192,194,16,133,32,148,1]
def L(input,inverse=False):
    state=list(input)
    for _ in range(16):
        if not inverse:
            x=state[15]
            for i in range(15):x^=mul(state[i],coeff[i])
            state=[x]+state[:15]
        else:
            x=state[0]
            for i in range(15):x^=mul(state[i+1],coeff[i])
            state=state[1:]+[x]
    return state
def matrix(fn):
    columns=[]
    for j in range(16):
        unit=[0]*16;unit[j]=1
        columns.append(fn(unit))
    return [[columns[j][i] for j in range(16)] for i in range(16)]
T=matrix(evaluate);LM=matrix(L);LI=matrix(lambda x:L(x,True))
for i in range(16):
    for j in range(16):
        assert T[i][j]==mul(r[i],mul(LM[i][j],c[j])),(i,j)
        assert LI[i][j]==LM[15-i][15-j]
        if i and j:assert T[i][j]==T[i-1][j-1]
assert T==json.loads((root/'toeplitz_optimized.json').read_text())['matrix']
seedbody=source[source.index('pub inline fn forwardSeeded('):source.index('pub inline fn inverseSeeded(')]
seednodes=dict(re.findall(r'const (w\d+) = ([^;]+);',seedbody))
def normalize(x):return re.sub(r'\b[vw](\d+)\b',r'n\1',x).replace('multiply(T,','multiply(TYPE,').replace('multiply(W,','multiply(TYPE,').replace(' ','')
for name,expr in nodes:
    number=int(name[1:])
    if number<=269:assert normalize(expr)==normalize(seednodes['w'+str(number)]),name
returns=re.findall(r'xor3\(W, (w\d+), (w\d+), @as\(W, @splat\(key\[(\d+)\]\)\)\)',seedbody)
assert len(returns)==16
nd=dict(nodes)
for i,(a,b,keyindex) in enumerate(returns):
    assert int(keyindex)==i
    assert normalize(nd[outputs[i].strip()])==normalize(a+' ^ '+b)
# Independently exercise complete encoded round equations with arbitrary round keys.
definitions=Path('/home/t3/kuznechik.zig/src/definitions.zig').read_text()
def table(name):
    data=re.search(r'pub const '+name+r': \[256\]u8 = \.\{([^}]+)\}',definitions)[1]
    return [int(x.strip(),0) for x in data.split(',') if x.strip()]
pi=table('pi_table');pinv=table('pi_inv_table')
def scale(s,v):return [mul(a,b) for a,b in zip(s,v)]
def xor(a,b):return [x^y for x,y in zip(a,b)]
def apply(M,v):
    out=[]
    for row in M:
        x=0
        for a,b in zip(row,v):x^=mul(a,b)
        out.append(x)
    return out
bar_r=r[::-1];bar_ri=ri[::-1];bar_ci=ci[::-1]
JTJ=[row[::-1] for row in T[::-1]]
for i in range(16):
    for j in range(16):assert JTJ[i][j]==mul(bar_r[i],mul(LI[i][j],c[15-j]))
rng=random.Random(0x746f65706c69747a)
for _ in range(128):
    keys=[[rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(16)] for _ in range(10)]
    invkeys=[L(k,True) for k in keys]
    x=[rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(16)]
    ref=list(x)
    for j in range(9):ref=L([pi[v] for v in xor(ref,keys[j])])
    ref=xor(ref,keys[9])
    e=scale(r,xor(x,keys[0]))
    for j in range(9):
        s=scale(ci,[pi[v] for v in scale(ri,e)])
        e=xor(apply(T,s),scale(r,keys[j+1]))
    assert scale(ri,e)==ref
    ref=list(x)
    for j in range(9):ref=[pinv[v] for v in L(xor(ref,keys[9-j]),True)]
    ref=xor(ref,keys[0])
    e=xor(apply(JTJ,scale(bar_ci,x)),scale(bar_r,invkeys[9]))
    for j in range(8):
        s=scale(bar_ci,[pinv[v] for v in scale(bar_ri,e)])
        e=xor(apply(JTJ,s),scale(bar_r,invkeys[8-j]))
    assert xor([pinv[v] for v in scale(bar_ri,e)],keys[0])==ref
result={'passed':True,'checks':['row/column inverse scalars','all256 matrix coefficients T=R*L*C','Toeplitz diagonals','reversal J*L*J=Linv','forwardSeeded graph identical with one key XOR per output','reversed decryption scaling','128 arbitrary-round-key encrypt/decrypt equation cases'], 'source_sha256':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [root/'toeplitz_core_broadcast.zig',root/'encoded_seeded_broadcast.zig']}}
Path('/home/t3/.cache/kuz-toeplitz-review/math-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
